spans.s: शौरसेनी f. Name of a Prākṛt dialect.
सौरसेनी f. The same as शौरसेनी q.v.
शौरि m. 1. An epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; 2. of Balarāma; 3. the planet Saturn.
सौर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Relating to the sun, solar; 2. sacred to the sun; 3. celestial, divine; 4. relating to spirituous liquor.
सौरी f. The wife of the sun.
सौरि m. 1. Name of the planet Saturn; 2. the Asana tree.
शौर्य n. 1. Valour, prowess, heroism, शौर्यं श्वापदचेष्टितम् R.xvii.47; 2. strength, might; 3. representation of supernatural events on the stage.
सौर्य a. (f. र्यी) Belonging to the sun, solar.
सौर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Relating to the sun, solar; 2. sacred to the sun; 3. celestial, divine; 4. relating to spirituous liquor.
सौर (II) m. 1. A worshipper of the sun; 2. the planet Saturn; 3. a solar month; 4. a solar day.
सौर (III) n. Name of a collection of hymns, (taken from the Ṛgveda) addressed to Sūrya.
सौर-नक्त n. a particular religious observance.
सौर-मास m. a solar month, (consisting of thirty risings and settings of the sun).
सौरथ m. A hero.
सौरभ (I) a. (f. भी) Fragrant.
सौरभ (II) n. 1. Fragrance; 2. saffron.
सौरभ (I) a. (f. भी) Fragrant.
सौरभी f. 1. A cow; 2. the daughter of Surabhi, तां सौरभेयीं सुरभिर्यशोभिः R.ii.3.
सौरभेय (I) a. (f. यी) Relating to Surabhi.
सौरभेय (II) m. An ox.
सौरभेय (I) a. (f. यी) Relating to Surabhi.
सौरभी f. 1. A cow; 2. the daughter of Surabhi, तां सौरभेयीं सुरभिर्यशोभिः R.ii.3.
सौरभ्य n. 1. Fragrance, odour, सौरभ्यमीप्सुरिव ते मुखमारुतस्य R.v.69; 2. agreeableness, beauty; 3. good character, good reputation, fame.
सौरसेन m. pl. Name of a country and its people.
सौरसेय m. An epithet of Skanda.
सौरसैंधव (I) a. (f. वी) Belonging to the river Ganges, Gangetic.
सौरसैंधव (II) m. A horse of the sun.
सौरसैंधव (I) a. (f. वी) Belonging to the river Ganges, Gangetic.
सौराज्य n. Good government, सौराज्यरम्यानपरो विदर्भान् R.v.60.
सौराष्ट्र (I) a. (f. ष्ट्रा or ष्ट्री) Relating to the district of Surāṣṭra.
सौराष्ट्र (II) m. the district of Surāṣṭra.
सौराष्ट्र (III) m. pl. The inhabitants of Surāṣṭra.
सौराष्ट्र (IV) n. Brass.
सौराष्ट्र (I) a. (f. ष्ट्रा or ष्ट्री) Relating to the district of Surāṣṭra.
सौराष्ट्र (I) a. (f. ष्ट्रा or ष्ट्री) Relating to the district of Surāṣṭra.
सौराष्ट्रक m. A sort of bell-metal.
सौराष्ट्रिक n. A sort of poison.
सौरि-रत्न n. sapphire.
सौरिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Celestial; 2. spirituous, vinous; 3. due for spirits, (such as money).
सौरिक (II) m. 1. Saturn; 2. heaven, paradise; 3. a vender of spirituous liquor.
सौरिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Celestial; 2. spirituous, vinous; 3. due for spirits, (such as money).
सौरीय a. (f. यी) 1. Solar; 2. suitable to the sun.
सौरीय a. (f. यी) 1. Solar; 2. suitable to the sun.
सौर्य a. (f. र्यी) Belonging to the sun, solar.
